records.title: Considerations in Care of the Patient with a Disability (*, max. 6)
records.header: ORALM 404 Considerations in Care of the Patient with a Disability (*, max. 6)
records.text: ORALM 404 Considerations in Care of the Patient with a Disability (*, max. 6) Role of auxiliaries in dental treatment of the special patient, including psychosocial issues, communication techniques, wheelchair transfers; dental prevention, medical and dental management of specific disabilities; drug therapy, sedation, and anesthesia. Offered: AWSpS.

records.title: Clinical Management of Patients with Disabilities (*, max. 10)
records.header: ORALM 460 Clinical Management of Patients with Disabilities (*, max. 10)
records.text: ORALM 460 Clinical Management of Patients with Disabilities (*, max. 10) Participation in chair/bedside dental treatment of a broad range of disabled populations, including homebound and institutionalized patients. Offered: AWSpS.
